subject: BlueFjord pilot: sizing questionnaire & ops alignment
messages:
From: Tim Roberts <tim@bluefjord.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@bluefjord.ai
Date: 2027-03-01T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Pilot sizing — quick context and sample payload

Hi Mina,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the team was impressed with the latency numbers. We want to kick off a 6-week pilot to validate a user-facing summarization flow. Before we commit resources on our side, procurement asked for a short sizing worksheet so they can align budgets and ask our infra team to carve out VPN access.

What we can share today: a 48-hour sample of production traffic (CSV) and a short description of our prompt mix. High-level constraints:
- Expected pilot peak: ~120 concurrent sessions (spiky, up to 250 briefly)
- Average prompt length: 120 tokens; average response length: 450 tokens
- Mix: 70% single-turn summaries, 20% multi-turn clarifications, 10% embeddings/metadata lookup calls

Attaching the 48-hour sample as requested. Can you send back the completed sizing worksheet + any preflight network/role requirements so we can get procurement moving? Ideal target start date: 2027-04-01.

Appreciate quick turnaround — procurement wants numbers by EOD Friday.

Thanks,
Tim
Director of Product
BlueFjord
[Attachment: bluefjord_workload_sample.csv (csv)]
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Tim Roberts <tim@bluefjord.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-03-01T11:04:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Pilot sizing — quick context and sample payload

Tim — thanks for the sample and the clear constraints. I ran a quick pass with our preflight tool and sketched a conservative pilot footprint to meet your latency SLOs while keeping unit cost visible for procurement.

Attached: redwood_dedicated_sizer.xlsx (basic outputs + assumptions) and a short preflight checklist (redwood_preflight_checklist.pdf). Highlights below:

- Proposed conservative commit for pilot (SLA target p95 latency <= 400ms for single-turn summaries): 4x A100-equivalent GPU workers (reserved), with autoscale headroom to 8x for short bursts.
- Estimated steady-state concurrency support: ~110 sessions at 120 prompt / 450 response token average assuming batching 6-8 and KV cache where applicable.
- Burst tolerance: we model a <30-minute burst window up to 250 concurrent sessions with queuing/slotted routing to dedicated spare capacity.
- Token throughput estimate (steady): ~ (120 prompts * 570 tokens avg per session) ≈ 68.4k tokens/minute peak sustained.
- Suggested telemetry: token-level cost, model variant fallback counts, per-route p95 latency tracing.

Open items for BlueFjord to confirm:
1) How strict is the 400ms p95 requirement — acceptable to have 95% under 400ms but p99 may spike?
2) Do you need private deployment (VPC) for pilot or is hosted with VPC peering enough?
3) Any compliance questionnaires we should expect before start?

If Marissa/Ben can weigh in below on GPU SKU and quantization tradeoffs, we can finalize the sizer and give procurement a committed monthly $ estimate.

Best,
Mina
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
[Attachments: redwood_dedicated_sizer.xlsx (spreadsheet), redwood_preflight_checklist.pdf (pdf)]
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-03-02T08:17:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Pilot sizing — pilot footprint thoughts

Mina / Ben — quick internal note before we send final numbers to Tim:

- GPU SKU: recommend A10G equivalent for cost-profile tests as long as quantized model is acceptable; if BlueFjord needs max perf for 400ms p95 we should propose 4x A100-equivalents with option to switch to A10G for cost test after week 2.
- Quantization: 4-bit LLAMAx-style yields 25–30% throughput improvement; need model artifact compatibility. Ask BF if they will accept minor accuracy delta.
- Autoscale policy: prefer scheduled burst windows + reactive scaling with an 8-10s stabilization window to avoid thrash.

I'll add SKU-level cost ranges into the workbook and return. Ben — can you add the telemetry endpoints + onboarding runbook items to the checklist?

-Marissa
Principal PM, Pre-Sales
From: Tim Roberts <tim@bluefjord.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@bluefjord.ai
Date: 2027-03-04T15:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Pilot sizing — quick context and sample payload

Mina / Marissa — this looks great, thanks. Procurement reviewed the workbook and asked for the following before they sign off:

- Final committed monthly spend estimate for the 6-week pilot (line-itemed by GPU SKU + network egress).
- A short list of network/IP ranges and the onboarding runbook to share with our infra team (VPN details).
- Confirmation we can toggle the fallback model to a slightly cheaper variant in case of sustained cost overrun.

We are fine with starting hosted + VPC peering for the pilot; if the pilot goes well we will discuss Private deployment. 400ms p95 is our target but p99 spikes are tolerable for <1% of requests during bursts.

Please send a single PDF we can attach to our PO and we'll push procurement. If you can get that to us today we can still hit the April 1 pilot start target.

Thanks,
Tim
Director of Product, BlueFjord
